biotools.summary: askWheat, part of the International Wheat Information System (WheatIS), federates wheat data resources in one search and a public MCP server: IWGSC RefSeq gene models and ID conversion across RefSeq v1.0, v1.1 and v2.1, Ensembl Plants homologues, the Watkins Wheat Pangenome (gene presence/absence, haplotypes and trial phenotypes), Cadenza and Kronos EMS mutant lines with seed ordering, RNA-seq expression, CropSNPdb SNP-array genotypes, OzWheat GWAS, INRAE GnpIS trials and germplasm (FAIDARE), GBIF genebank accessions and Europe PMC literature, with gene and genome browser views.
